annotations.text: LEAD (v2): v1's palette and type kept; tightened table, inline disambiguation row, match-confidence badges, mic dock with transcript. Mobile + export screens follow it.

ALTERNATE DIRECTIONS — same session, three different stances.
B Warm marquee: cinematic amber, serif titles, ticket rows. Tradeoff: less scannable at 100+ films.
C Paper ledger: light, mono, index-card utility; fastest to scan, least atmosphere.
D Transcript-first: chat is the product, films appear as cards in-line; great for Conversational mode, weaker for Quick Dump backlogs.
Untouched v1 export from Claude Design (Aug 25, 2026) for comparison.
